hooks.text: Ninety-five percent of the entire universe is completely invisible.
Only 5% of the universe is made of matter.
Everything you have ever seen is a tiny cosmic fragment.

title: Why Most of the Universe Is Invisible
description: Space feels empty, but invisible dark matter and dark energy shape the cosmos. Everything we can see makes up just 5% of reality.

beats.text: Ninety-five percent of the entire universe is completely invisible.

beats.text: Most people picture outer space as a vast, empty vacuum.

beats.text: In reality, it is packed with dark matter and dark energy.

beats.text: Dark matter acts like invisible glue, holding massive galaxies together.

beats.text: At the same time, dark energy accelerates the cosmos apart.

beats.text: Every star, planet, and moon makes up only 5%.
